products.name: Rhino
products.sdb_description: The “Rhino” possesses unparalleled firepower. Its Laser HMG can decimate large numbers of enemies, while the optional Grav Field Grenades create gravity wells which hold enemies still. The Rhino’s firepower comes at a price, as it sacrifices defensive capabilities.
products.description:
Marketed by Astrek Association as “the ultimate battlefield deterrent”, the AA-D01 “Rhino” possesses firepower that is unparalleled in New Eden. Armed with powerful weaponry and ordinance, the Rhino turns its operator into a one-man army. This firepower comes at a cost, however, as the frame is less armored than its counterparts.

The Rhino features several experimental systems which are designed to give operator the tactical advantage in practically every situation, with powerful kinetic attacks and state-of-the-art ordinance.

<label>Specialty (Passive) -</label> Personal Shield - When the Rhino activates an ability, it gains a personal shield that absorbs a small amount of damage.

<label>Charge -</label> Power is rerouted to the Rhino’s servos, giving the battleframe a momentary speed boost that can also trample enemies that stand in the Rhino’s way.

<label>Sundering Wave -</label> A wave of kinetic energy erupts from the Rhino, weakening enemies slightly while leaving them vulnerable to additional attacks for a short period.

<label>Gravity Field Grenade -</label> The Rhino can also be equipped with Gravity Field Grenades that detonate to form a gravity well. Any weapons fire that passes through the well is pulled into the center, while anyone caught near the well are held in place until the well dissipates.

<label>Dreadfield (HKM) -</label> Even in dire situations, the Rhino is built for survivability through offensive measures. Dreadfield surrounds the Rhino with an energy vortex that siphons energy from nearby enemies.  Increase the number of targets affected and damage dealt by the Rhino will consequently be increased.

While other Dreadnaughts use traditional ballistics or plasma projectiles, the Rhino implements a Heavy Laser Machine Gun which is more dangerous at range than the alternatives. The alternate fire for the HLMG is a single concentrated laser which can rip through a squad of enemies with ease, but consumes ammunition at an incredible rate.
products.instructions: Battleframes can be equipped from any Battleframe Garage or Battleframe Station found in towns throughout the world.

products.name: Firecat
products.sdb_description: The “Firecat” certainly lives up to its name, using super-heated plasma and flame jets to incinerate everything around the pilot. A Thermal Cannon launches volatile plasma which explodes into an inferno on impact. Jets on the chassis can expel flames to scorch nearby enemies.
products.description:
The Astrek Association “Firecat” Assault Battleframe certainly lives up to its name. Designed for close-quarters combat, the Firecat uses a combination of super-heated plasma and focused flames to incinerate the enemy and insulate the pilot from harm. The trade-off for such firepower is a drop in maneuverability and speed.

With a heavy focus on firepower, the Firecat is equipped with several offensive capabilities – each of which is based around the single theme of using flames to incinerate the opposition.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Incinerator -</label> When the Firecat deals damage with either abilities or its primary weapon's alternate fire, the enemy will burst into flame and take minor damage over time.

<label>Thermal Wave -</label> A flaming projectile which sets ablaze everything in its path, Thermal Wave is an attack that is felt long after the initial impact.

<label>Immolate -</label> When a Firecat operator finds himself surrounded by enemy forces, he can initiate Immolate to ignite the jets on the battleframe to momentarily project flame in all directions.

<label>Inferno Dash -</label> A dual-use ability, Inferno Dash allows the Firecat to project itself forward while igniting any enemies he happens to pass by.

<label>Fuel Air Bomb (HKM) -</label> Firecat operators have access to powerful ballistic ordinance. Named after its ordinance, the Fuel Air Bomb is a devastating strike in which the Firecat operator deploys an arcporter, which the bomb is dropped on. Upon detonation, the Fuel Air Bomb explodes in a ball of flame which scorches anyone caught in its blast.

The Firecat’s default weapon is the Astrek TC-1 Thermal Cannon. The Thermal Cannon fires a super-heated plasma projectile which bursts into flame on impact, covering a wide area with fire. The alternate fire option for the Thermal Cannon is a three-round Triple Shot, which fire in a straight trajectory and ignite the target in flames for a brief period.

products.name: Recluse
products.sdb_description: The “Recluse” takes the concept of a combat medic and reimagines it as a walking biological weapon, replacing the life-giving medical gasses with dangerous toxins. Recluse pilots are also given a Biogenic Crossbow, which can fire poisonous grenades at groups of targets.
products.description:
The Astrek Association’s “Recluse” Biotech battleframe takes the concept of combat medic and twists it into a biological weapon. Life-giving medical gasses are replaced with dangerous toxins, turning this lightly-armored battleframe into a potent and powerful combatant.

The Recluse has been gutted of any medical technology, and replaced with chemical and biological weaponry which can incapacitate an enemy in short order.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Necrotic Poison -</label> When the Recluse deals damage with an ability or its primary weapon's alternate fire, the enemy will become poisoned. The poison deals damage each second and can be reapplied by hitting an enemy with the Recluse's primary fire.

<label>Creeping Death -</label> Delivered via the Recluse’s BioCrossbow, this is a special projectile that will release a large cloud of poisonous gas when detonated. This cloud grows after impact, and can cripple enemies caught within.

<label>Evacuate -</label> Launching the Recluse backward at a high velocity, a large chemical cloud is left in the battleframe’s launch location.

<label>Kinetic Shot -</label> The BioCrossbow is also capable of firing a Kinetic Shot. As it travels it picks up speed, striking targets that are further away with increased damage over targets that are closer to the operator.

<label>Necrosis (HKM) -</label> The battleframe pumps a series of toxic chemicals out of the chassis in all directions, harming any enemy caught in its proximity.

Astrek Association has designed an experimental BioCrossbow to be used with the Recluse battleframe. While its rate of fire is slower than its competitors, it packs a larger punch with its toxin-laced bolts. An alternate form of fire is a toxic grenade which can be launched from the BioCrossbow and deliver poisonous gas that spreads after the explosion.

products.name: Tigerclaw
products.sdb_description: Designed for speed and maneuverability, the “Tigerclaw” utilizes a Fusion Cannon which focuses on direct impact over radial damage. The Tigerclaw can also launch missiles at enemies, or discharge a Disruption Wave to trap enemies, and can also redirect its exhaust to auxiliary tanks to restore energy.
products.description:
Birthed from necessity, the Omnidyne OD-M7 “Tigerclaw” was designed with speed and maneuverability in mind in order to compensate for the ever-evolving battlefield. To give the operator more maneuverability, the Tigerclaw is built with lightweight components which can’t take the same punishment as some other Assault alternatives.

The Tigerclaw was designed to allow its operator to move quickly across the battlefield while making only minimal sacrifices to firepower. The Tigerclaw is also capable of battlefield support for its allies.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Auxiliary Tanks -</label> When the Tigerclaw activates an ability, it will gain a boost to energy regeneration for a short time.

<label>Trail Blaze -</label> The Tigerclaw discharges a trail of energy forward. When passing through this trail, the Tigerclaw and its allies receive a brief increase in movement speed.

<label>Disruption Wave -</label> Launches a small energy projectile which traps an enemy within an energy field while also inflicting a small amount of damage.

<label>Tether Field (HKM) -</label> When launched, Tether Field will detonate to create a large energy field. While the energy field is not lethal, anything that attempts to leave it will be severely hindered.

Omnidyne-M has outfitted the Tigerclaw with a Type-5 Fusion Cannon, a lightweight alternative to the Accord’s Plasma Cannon. While the Fusion Cannon packs a formidable punch, it suffers from a very minor area of impact, minimally affecting groups of enemies. This problem is remedied by the Fusion Cannon’s alternate fire, which sends a plasma projectile on a flat trajectory which detonates for a larger area of effect.

products.name: Nighthawk
products.sdb_description: The “Nighthawk” is Omnidyne’s long-range recon frame. Utilizing a bolt-action rifle capable of punching through enemy armor, the Nighthawk is also outfitted with defensive contingencies. These include long-range explosives, and smoke screens to conceal its presence.
products.description:
Designed to have its presence felt without ever being seen on the battlefield, the Omnidyne OD-R02 “Nighthawk” specializes in staying far behind the front lines to pick off enemies with its powerful rifle and evasive systems.

The Nighthawk is not designed to engage in close-quarters combat, and is instead optimized for combat at range.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Ambush -</label> When the Nighthawk is not in enemy SIN, it deals extra damage. The effect can only occur once every 30 seconds.

<label>Execute Shot -</label> A specialized round for the Nighthawk’s sniper rifle, the Execute Shot is capable of taking out enemy combatants without incapacitation.

<label>Remote Explosive -</label> An explosive which sticks to any surface, including enemies. This charge is then detonated at the Nighthawk’s discretion.

<label>Smoke Screen -</label> The Nighthawk can deploy a smoke grenade to conceal its position, while hiding allies within the cloud from enemy SIN.

<label>Eruption Rounds (HKM) -</label> The Bolt Action Sniper Rifle can also be loaded with special Eruption Rounds, which explode either upon impact or when they come within proximity of an enemy.

The Nighthawk’s Bolt Action Sniper Rifle has a very slow rate of fire, but its impact is devastating. A headshot from the Nighthawk’s rifle will put down anything in its way. The addition of a scope increases its effective range.

products.name: Raptor
products.sdb_description: The “Raptor” comes equipped with a long-range Charge Rifle and several support contingencies. SIN Scramblers built into the suit can disrupt enemy radar, while its Teleport Beacon allows the pilot a quick escape. A Power Field can be deployed to supercharge an ally’s shields.
products.description:
The Astrek Association’s AA-R4 “Raptor” is the support frame to complement Astrek’s other, offense-heavy battleframes. Several evasion systems have been integrated into this battleframe, making it difficult to track in the chaos of a firefight.

Although the Raptor is more than capable of defending itself in a fight, its primary role is that of a long-range support. To that end, it has been outfitted with a number of secondary support systems.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Conduit -</label> Successfully hitting with the Raptor's primary weapon grants an electrical charge. Upon reaching three electrical charges, the Raptor's abilities become empowered and gain additional benefits or effects.

<label>SIN Scrambler -</label> A specialized round fired from the Raptor’s Charge Rifle, the SIN Scrambler confuses enemy radar and fools the opposition into thinking that the Raptor’s target is hostile.

<label>Power Field -</label> Designed to support the Raptor’s allies when deployed, the Power Field will supercharge any ally that passes through it, increasing their ammo capacity and rate of fire temporarily.

<label>Teleport Beacon -</label> A quick escape for a Raptor that finds itself in danger, the Teleport Beacon allows the operator to instantaneously warp from one location to another.

<label>Overload (HKM) -</label> The Raptor is also capable of channeling its energy directly into the Charge Rifle, allowing the operator to fire bolts of electricity which not only damage the target, but also nearby allies. The extra energy also allows the Charge Rifle to recharge more quickly.

Raptor operators utilize a Charge Rifle, a long-range sniper rifle, to thin enemy numbers from afar. When scoped, the Charge Rifle charges its shots to deal more damage based on the charge time.

products.sdb_description: Designed for combat support in volatile environments, the “Electron” lets its pilot be effective from range with a powerful Shock Rifle. The Shock Rifle is also used to detonate other Electron tech, like the Bulwark. This frame can create artificial electrical storms.
products.description:
One of Astrek Association’s most advanced chassis; the AA-E01 “Electron” is designed for combat support in the most volatile environments. Using long-range weaponry and experimental shields, the Electron is the offensive answer to the more defensive-minded Engineer frames.

The Electron is equipped with several attack-focused electronic devices, which gives the battleframe the offensive firepower lacking in other frames.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Failsafe -</label> When the Electron’s health is reduced below a certain point, the battleframe overloads and detonates an EMP blast which damages and drains all energy from enemies caught in the blast.

<label>Boomerang Shot -</label> A powerful electric bolt which passes through enemies out to a certain distance, then returns to the Electron. Enemies hit on the return are injured further.

<label>Overclocking Station -</label> When an Electron or any of its allies run over the pad, their servos are overclocked, granting a temporary surge in movement speed.

<label>Bulwark -</label> The Shock Rifle can also be used to discharge another projectile, known as the Bulwark. The Bulwark is fired from the Electron and detonates. Once detonated, any allied battleframes will absorb damage for a short period.

<label>Electrical Storm (HKM) -</label> A powerful projectile that can be detonated to grow into a large energy storm which inflicts great harm to enemy forces while also holding them in place.

The Shock Rifle, the primary weapon of the Electron, is a long-ranged precision rifle that can deal great amounts of damage in the hands of a capable shooter. Its alternate fire discharges a large projectile ball of energy which, when detonated by a round from the Shock Rifle, explodes to deal a moderate amount of radius damage.
products.instructions: Battleframes can be equipped from any Battleframe Garage or Battleframe Station found in towns throughout the world.

products.name: Arsenal
products.sdb_description: The Omnidyne-M D-647 “Arsenal” certainly lives up to its name, incorporating an unrivaled variety of weaponry at the pilot’s disposal. Equipped with a Primary Heavy Machine Gun that fires hundreds of .50-90 rounds a minute, the frame is also equipped with particle beams, shotguns, and shoulder-mounted rockets.
products.description:
The Omnidyne-M Arsenal could be best described as a toy box... of doom! The Arsenal has a tool for every job, a solution to every problem. The Arsenal’s ability suite focuses on weapon swaps, replacing the primary weapon with a temporary gun to serve a unique purpose. This armory on jump jets is for the discerning Battleframe pilot that understands that you can never have too many choices when it comes to crushing your foes.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Electromagnetic Pulse -</label> Arsenal pilots tend to be, unsurprisingly, fearless. They don't mind being close to the enemy, or even surrounded by them. That may have to do with the fact that every use of an ability activates their damaging passive ability, the Electromagnetic Pulse, in a point-blank area around the Arsenal. 

<label>Combat Shotgun -</label> Close encounters with the enemy are bound to happen, no matter what Battleframe you pilot. When designing the Arsenal loadout, Omnidyne-M considered this early on. What should one keep around in case of close encounters? Well, a quick-switch automatic combat shotgun, obviously! And what better way to complement a devastating boomstick than a generous speed boost to help you get even closer!

<label>Particle Beam -</label> Being outnumbered generally puts a pilot at a disadvantage. The Arsenal, however, relishes any reason to swap to their high tech Particle Beam! With a flash its beam of energy strikes with resounding success, blasting and dispersing enemies in a large radius. When you absolutely must kill an entire nest of Aranhas, accept no substitutes.

<label>Rocket Jump -</label> Jump jets, while incredibly useful on any Battleframe, can never hurt from a little extra oomph! Enter Rocket Jump, the most effective way to go straight up in the blink of an eye while delivering a painful jolt to enemies at the launch site. The ability also gives your jump jets a few extra moments of refined calibration, allowing for some tight turns while airborne. Do be careful and watch your head when indoors!

<label>Shoulder Rockets (HKM) -</label> The Arsenal has a weapon for every scenario, but here at Omnidyne-M we felt that just wasn't enough. Sometimes a pilot needs to leave that special exclamation at the end of the statement "I win!" In fact, we decided you should leave approximately 12 exclamation points at the end of that statement in the form of a barrage of Shoulder Rockets that smartly follow your targeting reticle. The enemy will get the message, as will the person cleaning them up later.

The Primary go-to armament on any Arsenal is the LMG; a reliable and effective dispenser of bullets that should persuade most to seek refuge. When not hurling steel at a high rate with surprising accuracy, this beast can change its ammo on-the-fly to pierce through enemies and some shielding, however, at a somewhat slower rate. There is nothing subtle about the LMG. It shoots straight, fast, and turns the hardest of targets to withered Swiss cheese.

products.name: Bastion
products.sdb_description: The “Bastion” utilizes defensive technologies to keep its pilot and allies safe in combat. Multiple upgradeable turrets can be placed at once, while special pods can be deployed to siphon energy and repair nearby weaponry. The frame’s Sticky Grenade Launcher lobs explosives across the battlefield.
products.description:
The Omnidyne OD-E12 “Bastion” is Omnidyne-M’s answer to the Accord Engineer, with an added emphasis on being a defensive specialist. To aid in its efforts, the Bastion is stocked with several deployable electronics which can protect its allies and turn the tide of any fight.

Specializing in defensive deployable items gives the Bastion the advantage of essentially having a presence in multiple locations on the battlefield at one time. This makes the Bastion uniquely capable, even among other Engineer frames.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Overseer -</label> Bastion causes its nearby deployables to take reduced damage from all sources.

<label>Multi-Turrets -</label> The Bastion is capable of deploying multiple turrets across the battlefield. These turrets can be upgraded to provide different forms of weapons fire.

<label>Sentinel Pod -</label> While the primary purpose of the Sentinel Pod is to repair allied turrets and other deployed electronics, it can also siphon energy from nearby enemies to inflict minor damage.

<label>Energy Wall -</label> The Bastion can also fire a projectile that, when detonated, erects a large impenetrable Energy Wall.

<label>Fortify (HKM) -</label> The Bastion is able to reinforce the structural integrity of all deployed electronics within range, restoring their energy and increasing their output for a brief period.

The Bastion features a Tesla Rifle which is built into the suit. This Tesla Rifle fires a focused beam of electricity which only reaches short distances. The amount of inflicted harm increases exponentially as the beam maintains its impact on a target. The beam is inversed with its alternate fire, draining energy from enemy forces.

products.name: Dragonfly
products.sdb_description: The ultimate in combat support, the “Dragonfly” was designed to support Omnidyne’s Mammoth and Tigerclaw frames. The Dragonfly is built with small canisters of life-rejuvenating gas inside the jumpjets. The BioRifle, the default weapon of the Dragonfly, is a capable sidearm.
products.description:
Designed by Omnidyne-M to be the ultimate in combat support, the OD-B9 “Dragonfly” Biotech battleframe is without equal in regards to combatant health. While it lacks truly devastating offensive firepower, it more than makes up for it with several systems designed by Omnidyne-M’s top scientists to ensure that battlefield health is never compromised.

The Dragonfly was designed with the absolute latest in medical technology. Its cutting-edge systems make it head-and-shoulders the preferred battleframe for soldiers placing medical support over combat.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Rally -</label> Any of the Dragonfly's allies that are below a certain health percentage will receive an extra heal over time when healed. The heal over time stops when the ally takes damage.

<label>Healing Ball -</label> Targeted at allies, the Dragonfly can fire a ball of concentrated energy which will explode on impact and revitalize any ally caught in its blast.

<label>Healing Pillar -</label> Similar to the Healing Ball, only this strikes against the ground to create a circle which erupts in a pillar of energy which heals any ally passing through it.

<label>Emergency Response -</label> When a soldier requires medical attention quickly, the Dragonfly is capable of projecting itself across the battlefield at high speeds. The trail of gas left behind heals allies who walk through it.

<label>Healing Dome (HKM) -</label> The Dragonfly can deploy a Healing Dome, creating a dome of protective energy around the Dragonfly. Allies who travel into the dome receive significant healing until either they leave or the dome collapses.

The Omnidyne-M OD-BR BioRifle is the weapon of choice for the Dragonfly, capable of firing off energy projectiles at a high rate of fire to keep the enemy at bay. The alternate fire for the BioRifle is a small-scale Heal Wave, which does moderate restoration to allies and small damage to enemies.

products.name: Mammoth
products.sdb_description: The Omnidyne-M “Mammoth” is the sturdiest battleframe in circulation. Using a modified Plasma HMG, the Mammoth can defend itself using energy domes and shields. A Personal Arcport allows the battleframe to travel great distances, countering its slow movement.
products.description:
Initially developed in hopes of replacing the aging Accord Dreadnaught, the Omnidyne "Mammoth" provides unrivaled protection against everything short of anti-aircraft fire. In addition to its heavy plating, the Mammoth is also built with several state-of-the-art defensive systems which not only benefit its operator, but allies on the battlefield as well.

The Mammoth is built to withstand the punishment of an entire army, and to that end can deploy several defensive systems designed to minimize enemy impact.

<label>Specialty (Passive) - Imminent Threat -</label> Enemies near the Mammoth take additional damage from all sources.

<label>Thunderdome -</label> When deployed, a dome of protective energy is erected over the Mammoth that protects anyone within from enemy fire. Allies can pass freely in and out of the dome.

<label>Shield Wall -</label> A static wall of protective energy is erected in front of the Mammoth, protecting it from enemy fire while allowing the Mammoth to fire through it. Allies behind the wall are also partially shielded.

<label>Teleport Shot -</label> A personal arcport device that can be deployed by the Mammoth. Once it lands, the Mammoth will teleport to that location. This also damages enemies that the Teleport Shot impacts against.

<label>Tremors (HKM) -</label> The Mammoth’s emergency contingency is referred to as Tremors, in which the battleframe emits a series of seismic waves for several seconds. These waves drive enemies back while also causing injury and slowing their movements.

The Mammoth is armed with a Heavy Plasma Machine Gun, which fires plasma rounds at a very high rate of fire. These rounds explode on impact, causing minor injury to enemies near the target. The alternate fire for the HPMG sees the projectiles travel faster, and momentarily slows the target on impact.
